ideas.title: Minnesota Voter Roll Scrutiny Escalates
ideas.description: Investigate the escalating voter-roll scrutiny in Minnesota and its implications for election integrity.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to understand the scope of the issue.
questions: What are the specific concerns driving voter-roll scrutiny?
How widespread is the issue across Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential vulnerabilities in Minnesota's election systems and shed light on efforts to ensure election integrity.

ideas.title: FBI Raids Elections Offices
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI raids on elections offices, including in Georgia and Fulton County, and their connection to Trump's push to relitigate the 2020 election.
ideas.angle: Examine the impact on election integrity and potential implications for future elections.
questions: What specific records are being sought by the FBI?
How do these raids relate to Trump's efforts to challenge the 2020 election?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal new information about ongoing investigations into election integrity and their potential impact on future elections.
